title: 第十三章 给我求饶

如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    “唰。”楚枫身形向旁一闪，便躲开了楚成的攻击。
与此同时单脚点地，猛然旋转，一记转身后鞭腿便抽了出去。
见状，楚成脸色微变，身形赶忙向后退去，可奈何楚枫的鞭腿不仅速度奇快，且位置刁钻，根本无法躲避。
慌忙之下，楚成只好双臂交加，硬挡下楚枫的攻击。
“踏踏踏...”
一腿扫中，楚成被震的连退数步，双臂之间阵阵酥麻之感不断传来。
这一刻，楚成眉头微皱，他无论如何也想不到，楚枫会有这么大的力气。
这样的实力，已完全超乎他的预料，让他不得不认真对待。
“有两下子，不过只凭一身蛮力，终究难成大器，我让你见识一下，武技的威力。”
“啪啪啪啪”
“喝啊”
楚成数指连点身体穴位，猛然爆喝一声，衣服竟瞬间鼓涨了许多，两双拳也增大了不少。
并且，他的肌肤也是由白变紫，浮出道道青筋，甚是恐怖。
“强化型武技”
楚枫双眼微眯，他看得出楚成使用的，乃是一种强化型武技。
这种武技，不会在招数上有所变化，但是个人的体制却会得到提升。
修炼到某种地步，水火不侵，刀枪不入，整个身体就是一件凶器。
见楚枫神色有所变化，楚成顿时得意起来，楚枫的实力虽让他意外，不过他却知道，没有修炼过武技，就是楚枫最大的弱点。
而他施展的武技，名叫钢铁之躯，凭借这个武技，他与同等修为的人肉身对战，几乎无敌，所以他有着绝对的信心，可以击败楚枫。
“楚枫，你现在跪地求饶，还....”

可还不待他将话说完，楚枫身形猛然一晃，竟消失不见。
当楚枫再次出现之时，已是楚成身前，一记强力的重拳，正在他的眼前不断放大。
“你这是自取其辱。”
见楚枫竟还敢与他肉身对战，楚成冷笑一声，同样一拳轰出，竟对着楚枫的拳头轰去。
两拳相对，居然发出如钢铁碰撞般的声音。
只不过交锋过后，楚成竟再次倒退数步，拳上的酥麻感不减反增，而再观楚枫，竟未退半步。
“这家伙肉身怎会如此强悍。”
楚成终于意识到了不对，凭借他所修炼的武技，同层次中几乎没人敢与他硬碰硬。
可是眼下，楚枫不但硬碰硬，而且还完全占据了上风，这让他感到极为不妙。
“唰。”
突然，楚枫身形向前一窜，单掌击出，再次对着楚成的面门袭来。
有了前两次教训的楚成，这次不再强接，而是瞄准楚枫的手腕，一把抓去。
这一次，楚成同样施展了武技，是一种奇快的擒拿手，所以还不待楚枫反应过来，他已是一把抓住了楚枫的手腕。
“这...”
可还不待楚成高兴，他便惊愕的发现，自己的擒拿手竟抓空了，先前直奔面门的手掌，已凭空消失。
“呜哇”
就在他吃惊的功夫，一记强有力的手掌，已是狠狠的落在了他的胸口之上。
楚枫这一掌，力道极强，将楚成足足打出十米远后才摔落在地，大口鲜血喷了出来。
这一幕，让一旁观战的楚真目瞪口呆，他无论如何也想不到，连灵武四重的楚成，也会败在楚枫手中。
这已经超出了他的承受范围，毕竟在此之前，他眼中的楚枫就是一个废到不能再废的废物。

“怎么会这样...”
而此刻楚成的脸上，除了痛苦之外，更多的也是震惊。
因为他想不通，想不通自己明明抓住楚枫的手腕，又怎会被楚枫打中。
“难道说..他修炼了武技？”
“不可能，绝对不可能，他进入内门才十日，怎么可能掌握武技。”
楚成觉得，楚枫施展的不可能是武技，因为十日之内，根本无法掌握一门武技。
但如果让他知道，楚枫施展的不仅是武技，而且还是内门最强的武技虚幻掌的话，不知他会作何感想。
“大哥。”就在这时，楚真跑了过来，搀扶起楚成便想逃走。
他是真的慌了，只要想到连楚成都已不是楚枫的对手，他唯一想做的便是逃。
“两位，别急着走哇。”
可就在这时，楚枫却无声无息的出现，拦住了两人的去路。
“楚枫，你想怎样？”
楚真故作镇定，但仍然无法掩饰内心的恐惧。
因为此刻的楚枫，与他印象中的完全不同，简直就是变了一个人，这样的变化，让他为之恐惧。
“不想怎样，把你们身上的东西都交出来，再给我跪地求饶，我就饶了你们”楚枫的脸上挂着微笑，可这样的微笑却更让人胆寒。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast channel. "Whoa." Chu Feng dodged to the side and dodged Chu Cheng's attack.
At the same time, he touched the ground with one foot, spun suddenly, and whipped his leg out after turning around.
Seeing this, Chu Cheng's expression changed slightly, and he hurriedly stepped back. However, Chu Feng's whip legs were not only extremely fast, but also in a tricky position, making it impossible to avoid them.
In a hurry, Chu Cheng had no choice but to cross his arms and block Chu Feng's attack.
"Tap tap tap..."
Chu Cheng was shocked and took several steps back after a leg sweep, and he felt numbness in his arms.
At this moment, Chu Cheng frowned slightly. He never imagined that Chu Feng would have such great strength.
Such strength was completely beyond his expectations, and he had to take it seriously.
"It took a while, but it's hard to become a great weapon with just brute strength. Let me show you the power of martial arts."
"Pah, pah, pah, pah"
"Drink"
Chu Cheng clicked on the acupuncture points on his body with several fingers, and suddenly let out a loud roar. His clothes suddenly bulged up a lot, and his two pairs of fists also became a lot bigger.
Moreover, his skin also turned from white to purple, with veins appearing, which was very scary.
"Enhanced Martial Arts"
Chu Feng narrowed his eyes slightly, and he could see that what Chu Cheng used was an enhanced martial skill.
This kind of martial arts will not change in the moves, but the personal structure will be improved.
After cultivating to a certain point, one becomes invulnerable to fire, water, and weapons, and one's entire body becomes a weapon.
Seeing the change in Chu Feng's expression, Chu Cheng suddenly became proud. Although Chu Feng's strength surprised him, he knew that Chu Feng's greatest weakness was that he had not practiced martial arts before.
The martial skill he used was called Body of Steel. With this martial skill, he was almost invincible in physical combat with people of the same cultivation level, so he had absolute confidence that he could defeat Chu Feng.
"Chu Feng, you kneel down and beg for mercy now, and you still..."
But before he could finish his words, Chu Feng suddenly swayed and disappeared.
When Chu Feng appeared again, he was already in front of Chu Cheng, and a powerful punch was magnifying in front of his eyes.
"You're doing this to yourself."
Seeing that Chu Feng still dared to fight him physically, Chu Cheng sneered and punched Chu Feng's fist as well.
The two fists faced each other and made a sound like the collision of steel.
However, after the confrontation, Chu Cheng actually took a few steps back again. The numbness in his fists increased instead of decreasing. However, when he looked at Chu Feng again, he didn't take even half a step back.
"How can this guy be so physically strong?"
Chu Cheng finally realized something was wrong. With his martial arts skills, almost no one at the same level dared to confront him head-on.
But now, Chu Feng not only faced off head-on, but also had the upper hand, which made him feel extremely uncomfortable.
"Uh-huh."
Suddenly, Chu Feng jumped forward, struck out with a single palm, and attacked Chu Cheng's face again.
Chu Cheng, who had learned lessons from the previous two times, no longer forced the attack this time, but aimed at Chu Feng's wrist and grabbed it.
This time, Chu Cheng also used martial arts, a very fast grappling technique, so before Chu Feng could react, he had already grabbed Chu Feng's wrist.
"This..."
But before Chu Cheng could be happy, he was shocked to find that his grasping hand was empty, and the palm that had gone straight to the door had disappeared out of thin air.
"Wow"
Just when he was surprised, a strong palm fell hard on his chest.
Chu Feng's palm was extremely powerful, and it knocked Chu Cheng ten meters away before he fell to the ground and a large mouthful of blood spurted out.
This scene made Chu Zhen, who was watching the battle, stunned. He never imagined that even Chu Cheng, who was at the fourth level of Lingwu, would be defeated by Chu Feng.
This was beyond his endurance. After all, before this, Chu Feng in his eyes was a useless waste."How could this happen..."
At this moment, Chu Cheng's face showed more than pain, but also shock.
Because he couldn't figure out how he could be hit by Chu Feng when he clearly grabbed Chu Feng's wrist.
"Could it be that... he has practiced martial arts?"
"Impossible, absolutely impossible. He has only been in the inner sect for ten days, how can he master martial arts."
Chu Cheng felt that what Chu Feng performed could not be a martial skill, because he could not master a martial skill within ten days.
But if he were told that Chu Feng was not only performing martial arts, but also the strongest martial art in the inner sect, Illusory Palm, I wonder what he would think.
"Brother." At this moment, Chu Zhen ran over, helped Chu Cheng up and tried to escape.
He was really panicked. As soon as he thought that even Chu Cheng was no longer Chu Feng's opponent, the only thing he wanted to do was to escape.
"You two, don't leave in a hurry."
But at this moment, Chu Feng appeared silently and blocked the way of the two of them.
"Chu Feng, what do you want?"
Chu Zhen pretended to be calm, but still could not hide the fear in his heart.
Because the Chu Feng at this moment was completely different from the one he remembered. He was simply a different person. Such a change frightened him.
"If you don't want to do anything, hand over everything you have on you, and then kneel down and beg for mercy, and I will spare you." Chu Feng had a smile on his face, but this smile made people even more frightened.
